newsitem.title: THAILAND: FAS sells fixed assets to Securities One.
newsitem.headline: FAS sells fixed assets to Securities One.

text.p: First Asia Securities Plc said on Monday it has agreed to sell 90 million baht ($3.46 million) of fixed assets to Securities One.
First Asia said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand the assets included its information technology department and margin accounts.
The assets sale, to be completed by end-February, was part of Securities One's takeover of First Asia that began last year.
Securities One had taken over First Asia's 306 retail margin accounts worth 1.15 billion baht, the statement said. First Asia's 264 staffers were recently transferred to Securities One.
It said proposed delisting of First Asia shares would be discussed by its shareholders on March 17.

After its merger with Securities One, First Asia will remain a member broker of the Stock Exchange of Thailand and continue to hold three securities licences and operate three securities trading offices.

First Asia said it had appointed Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc as financial adviser on its planned delisting. First Asia and Securities One on Friday agreed to sell their holdings in regional brokerage Asia Equity Holdings Plc to Banque Paribas.
